text:
**Your toddler comes first. Please contact poison control or a doctor right now**, before anything else. Tell them it was a peace lily leaf, and have the plant's name and your toddler's age handy. If your toddler has trouble breathing or seems very unwell, call emergency services. I don't have safety guidance beyond this, so please follow the medical professionals' advice. Keep the plant well out of reach in the meantime.

**Once your toddler is taken care of, here's what to do about the pot:**
- A cracked or smashed pot counts as damaged on arrival, so you're covered.
- Report it within **48 hours of delivery** (the plant arrived today) with photos of the item and the box.
- You can choose a **free replacement on the next plant shipping day**, or a **refund**.
- A replacement for damage on arrival doesn't use up the Plant Care Guarantee's one replacement.

If you'd like a replacement, I'd suggest asking for a different plant, or at least keeping any new peace lily well out of your toddler's reach. If you'd like me to escalate this to a Support Lead, just say so.

I hope your little one is okay.
